Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this match. Sadly, once again it was a one-sided affair with India thumping Sri Lanka for the umpteenth time on this tour. Now, they will travel back home to host an ODI series against Australia. The Lankans on the other hand have a series coming up against Pakistan shortly. We look forward to your company for all the matches in future. Until next time, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

Man of the Match and Series, Virat Kohli is all smiles. Says that it's a special win. Credits his boys for the hunger and feels that it's an evidence of their bench strength. He is very happy as a captain. On his batting, he replies that he backs his strength and enjoys playing all the formats. Admits that there was pressure when two wickets went down but it was all about staying calm and building a partnership. Praises Manish Pandey for his handy knock and finishing it well.

Upul Tharanga says that they were 15-20 runs short. Admits that they lost the momentum in the middle overs. Praises Virat Kohli for his outstanding batting. Feels that was the difference. On positives, he replies that their fielding was outstanding.

It wasn't an easy target for the Men in Blue. And once they lost Rohit Sharma and KL Rahul inside the Powerplay, it became tougher. However, Virat Kohli and Manish Pandey soaked all the pressure of a run chase and orchestrated one of the most clinical chases. They went hammer and tongs and punished the insipid Lankan bowling to all parts of the ground. The hosts never got a sniff to come back after that and surrendered meekly, like they did throughout this Indian tour. To say that Sri Lankan cricket is in shambles will be an understatement.

Easy-peasy! Yet another comfortable win for India and they finish their tour with the scoreline reading 9-0! They were ruthless in the Test series, dominated the ODIs and now crushed the Lankan Lions in the only T20I match. The home side will be breathing a huge sigh of relief that this tour has ended. They're beaten black and blue in every aspect of the game as the Indian team tamed the Lions in their own den.

FOUR! Manish Pandey finishes it off in style! A length delivery in the channel outside off, Pandey knows that the field is up and hence takes the chance to go over the top. Nails his shot over mid off and finds the fence. Handshakes all around. INDIA WIN BY 7 WICKETS!
A low full toss down the leg side, Dhoni nudges it to fine leg for a run.
Angling into the batsman, Pandey tickles it off his pads through mid-wicket and picks up a couple of runs. 2 more needed.
FOUR! Eased away! Short delivery outside off, slower in pace, Pandey has ample time to crash it through extra cover for a boundary.
Bowls it wide outside off, Pandey strokes it through covers and returns for the second run.
MS Dhoni walks in next.

OUT! Totally against the run of play. Udana serves a fuller length delivery in the line of the stumps, Kohli leans across and unfurls an effortless flick shot. Plays it in the air with the intention to clear mid-wicket. However, there isn't enough distance behind the shot. Shanaka near the fence catches it calmly to bring an end to an outstanding knock. 10 needed off 9 balls.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Pandey plays it with an angled bat and guides it to short third man. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Fantastic shot! Brilliant use of the bottom hand. Full and angling into the batsman, Kohli murders it with his wrists and sends it with utter disdain to the mid-wicket fence.
Too full and outside off, Pandey squeezes it out to third man for a run.
Fails to make much use of the Free Hit! Fuller and outside off, it's driven straight to extra cover for a single.
Beamer! A high full toss down the leg side, Kohli swings and misses. The keeper flies to his left and deflects it towards fine leg. A couple of runs taken. Called a no ball. Free Hit coming up...
An overpitched ball outside off, it's drilled square of the wicket where the point fielder made a diving stop. A single taken.
A low full toss on off, Kohli strokes it through covers and takes a single. He turns for the second run but Pandey sends him back. Good call.
Pitches it full and outside off, Pandey gets down on one knee, uses his wrists and drives it through cover-point for a run.
Walks forward to take it on the full and slogs it down to long on for one.
Loopy and outside off, shaping away, Kohli taps it down towards short third man for a run.
Eases a full ball down through mid off for a single. Rotating the strike quite well.

Too full in length on middle, Kohli sends his flick shot like a rocket to widish long on for a single. Another stat to his name. Kohli now has most runs in run chases in T20Is, going past Brendon McCullum!
Flighted on off, driven through mid off for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Angling into the batsman, Kohli works it through mid-wicket for a single. 100-run stand comes up!

FOUR! Nearly took the head of the umpire. Fuller length ball on middle, Kohli gets behind the line and bludgeons it straight back. Umpire Ruchira Palliyaguruge just manages to evade it as it speeds away to the fence in no time.
Fullish and wide outside off, Kohli chases it away from his body and edges it down to third man. Dilshan Munaweera nearly made a mess in the deep. A couple taken.
Hits the yorker mark around off, Pandey does well to squeeze it out towards point and collects a single.
Slower delivery, too full and outside off, Virat walks forward and pushes it to long off for a single.
A wide yorker outside off, Kohli tries to dig it out but is beaten for pace.
Lasith Malinga is back on. 38 needed off 30 balls.
Skidding back in, Kohli goes back and forces it through mid-wicket for one.
Sharp away spin there, Kohli pushes at it and misses.
Flatter and shorter on middle, stroked down towards mid on and the bowler ran after it. A single taken again.
Spinning back into the batsman from around off, Kohli opens the face of the bat and helps it to short third man for one.
Loopy full ball outside off, Pandey drives it down through mid off for one.
Flatter and around off, Virat gets back and punches it through mid-wicket for one.
Fullish and around middle, a fine wristy flick through mid-wicket by Pandey for a couple. 43 needed from 36 balls.
Slower full ball on off, Kohli advances down the track and pushes it towards point for one. Virat Kohli becomes the third highest run-scorer in T20Is!
Short and wide outside off, slower in place, Pandey decides late to play at it. Places it to the right of short third man and takes a single.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.

Three wides! That beats the keeper! A cross-seam delivery is banged into the batsman. It flies over Kohli and Dickwella only manages to get some gloves on it. The ball slows down and they take a couple.
On the pads, helped to short fine leg for a run.
A low full toss outside off, Kohli plays a drive in the air but it goes safely over covers. A single.
Isuru Udana is back on. 52 needed from 42 balls.
Plays it late with the spin but finds short third man. Looks for a run but the skipper screams no.
Slower and on middle, punched down through mid-wicket for a run.
Wide! This one is way wide outside off. Kohli leaves.

Appeal for a run out! Flighted ball on middle, Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket and turns back for the second run. The fielder scores a direct hit at the keeper's end and it's referred upstairs. The replays find Kohli safe.
FOUR! Even better! This time Kohli shimmies down the track to a full ball and hammers it past the bowler for a boundary at long off.

Continues to march along! Fourth consecutive fifties for Virat Kohli against Sri Lanka in T20Is. He just loves scoring against them. A flighted full ball on off, the Indian talisman drills it past extra cover for another couple of runs. India are running away with this game.
Fuller and wider outside off, Kohli reaches out for it and drives it past the diving extra cover fielder for a couple of runs.
Bowling change. Seekkuge Prasanna is back on.
Straighter in line, Kohli works it through mid-wicket for a run. 17 off the over, 65 needed off 48 balls!
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Mathews is put off the radar here. Short and wide outside off, Manish jumps on the back foot to dominate the bounce and slams it over point for a boundary. This partnership is pushing Sri Lanka on the back foot.
SIX! Pandey is matching shot for shot with his skipper. Fuller in length and outside off, Pandey keeps his weight on the back foot and launches it over long off for a biggie.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Quality shot! Fuller in length on middle, Kohli uses his wrists of steel and whips it through mid-wicket for a cracking boundary. He makes those flick shots look amazing. 50-run stand comes up off just 33 balls!
Kohli hangs on the back foot and punches it through covers for a single.
Long hop on middle, on the slower side, 79 kph, Pandey pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
A leg spinner on the shorter side outside off, Virat punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, Pandey chips it over mid on for a run.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Good stop in the deep! Floated full ball on middle, Kohli uses his feet and whips it through mid-wicket. A diving stop in the deep by the long on fielder and they take a couple of runs.

FOUR! Hammered away! But was there a chance? The fielder for some reason was standing up and had he been on the edge of the boundary line, he could have taken the catch. A delivery around middle and leg has been dismissed across the line over mid-wicket. The fielder rushes across to his right in the deep, then puts in a dive but fails to get to the ball.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Slower delivery around off, Pandey initially winds up for a big shot but then realizes the pace is on the slower side. Adjusts well and caresses it to long off for one.
Slower full ball on off, Kohli walks forward and eases it down through mid on for a run.
FOUR! Shot! Kohli is in unstoppable form. A lollypop delivery, shortish and outside off, the Indian skipper latches onto it and smacks it through covers for a boundary.
Mid off drops back. Third man comes up...

FOUR! Welcome into the attack, Thisara! A touch short in length around middle, angling in, Kohli brings his bottom hand into play and unfurls a half pull. It races through backward square leg and finds the fence.
Thisara Perera is into the attack now.
Kohli has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Goes deep inside the crease and punches it through covers for a single.
Goes down on one knee and swings it over mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Delicate from the King! A flatter and shorter ball on off, Kohli stays back inside the crease and at the very last moment runs it past the keeper for a boundary. Almost off Dickwella's gloves.
Shortish and around leg, Kohli whips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Akila Dananjaya to bowl.
Flatter and outside off, Pandey tries cutting but misses. The keeper fumbles and they cross for a bye.
Drags his length short and it's pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Skips down the track and mistimes his shot down towards long on for one.
Loopy and on off, driven through cover-point for a single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.

SIX! Boom! Out of here. Prasanna tosses it up in the air and lands it full around middle, Kohli gets the chance to get inside the line as he advances down the track and he absolutely thwacks it over the bowler's head.
Almost drags it on! Mathews takes the pace off the delivery, bowls it on a length at 111 kph, Pandey tries to heave across the line but is early into the shot. Gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Shortish and outside off, played down towards point who stopped it on one bounce.
Good length delivery outside off, Manish pushes it behind point and comes back for the second run.
A little bit of swing in the air as it lands full around off. This time Kohli plays it with soft hands through cover-point and collects a run.
Full in length and around off, Pandey pushes it with an angled bat through cover-point for a single.
Angelo Mathews is back on.
Turns it off his pads to mid-wicket for one.
Pandey has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Manish Pandey walks in next.

OUT! What. A. Catch. Take a bow, Dasun Shanaka. Tossed up ball on off, fuller in length, Rahul tries to play an inside-out shot with the spin but fails to make the proper connection. As a result, he fails to find the desired elevation. It flies to extra cover where Shanaka throws his body to his left and takes a stunning catch. Prasanna has a wicket. They are all pumped up. You can sense different energy in the field from the Lankan Lions.
Flighted leg spinner outside off, KL gets close to the line of the delivery and then plays the cut shot. Finds point.
Fine shot! A flighted full ball on off, Rahul strides forward and drives it through extra cover for a couple of runs. Dominating running between the wickets.
Flatter delivery on off, Kohli plays a late cut towards short third man for a run.
Seekkuge Prasanna is into the attack.

Full and angling into the batsman around off, Kohli pushes it with gentle hands to mid-wicket and scampers across to the other end. The fielder misses his shy otherwise it would have been close. 15000 international runs for King Kohli!
Nice wristwork! Good length ball around off, Rahul rotates his wrists and helps it through backward square leg for one.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Sharp delivery, on a good length outside off, Kohli taps it wide of point and calls for a quick single. Rahul responds and runs to the striker's end where Prasanna misses his shy.

In the air... Catch it is the shout... drops safe! Ooohhh... A back of a length delivery on middle and off, Kohli tries to punch it straight from the back foot but it bounces a bit more on his bat and flies just over the cover fielder. Two runs taken.
Wide! A bit short and down the leg side, Kohli tries to glance but misses.

Back of a length delivery on off, Kohli dabs it down to backward point and rushes to the other end. A direct hit at the non-striker's end but the Indian captain is safely in. The ball deflects towards mid-wicket, no one is present in that region and Kohli wants the second. Rahul is unaware but eventually responds.
Udana attempts for the yorker but the execution is poor. A low full toss on the pads and it's eased behind square leg for a couple. 8 from the over!

FOUR! Brilliantly done! A change in pace delivery by Udana, Rahul picks it early and waits for it. The length is on the shorter side which works to his advantage. He keeps his weight on the back leg and smashes it over covers for a boundary. There was a sweeper in place but he failed to cut it off.
Short again, around off, this time Kohli swivels and pulls it in front of square leg for a run. Off the mark!

Beaten again! The Indian skipper is having a nervy beginning. Udana gets one to move away from the batsman, it's a shade short in length and Kohli feels for it. Once again it wasn't very far away from the outside edge.
On a length and outside off, Rahul taps it down to point for one.
An overpitched delivery outside off, Rahul plays a lovely flowing cover drive but fails to find the gap.

Peach of a delivery! Beats the Indian skipper all ends up. Malinga is looking in good rhythm tonight. He has his tail up after picking the wicket of Rohit Sharma. Delivers a length ball around off, Kohli stays back to work it on the leg side but it swerves away to beat the outside edge. Nearly edged it. Exemplary first over by Slinga, 2 runs and a wicket from it!
Angles in a full ball on off, shaping away a shade, Rahul runs it down to third man and takes a single.
Skipper Virat Kohli arrives.

OUT! Malinga gets rid of Rohit! A big wicket for the Lankans. Back of a length delivery around off, Sharma sticks back to power it across the line over the leg side. But he fails to middle his shot. It flies off the top edge and Perera calls for it from mid on. He settles underneath it and takes the skier safely. Lasith draws first blood!
Good length ball on off, Rohit pushes it back from the upper half of the bat. That one stopped a bit onto the batsman.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Off pace delivery, landing just ahead of a length. Rahul reaches out for it and taps it to point.
Lasith Malinga replaces Mathews in the attack.
Slower delivery outside off, Rohit is early into his attempted square cut and hence misses.
Stays back and taps it down wide of short third man for one.
On a length and around off, Rohit punches it from the crease to covers. Finds the gap and takes a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Rohit tries playing it late but fails to middle. Gets it from the bottom edge and it goes over the keeper for a couple.
Fullish and on leg, KL helps it wide of mid on for a run.

FOUR! Great shot! Too full in length around off, angling away, Rahul leans into the drive and thumps it over point for a boundary. He did well there to open the face of the bat in order to get the placement right.
Isuru Udana to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! The line is wrong and Rohit makes him pay. He just picks it off his pads and deflects it past the diving short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Malinga was stationed there and he actually dived over the ball. Excellent start for India!
Slower in pace, around off on a length, KL plays it with soft hands at backward point where Prasanna dives to stop the ball. Still a single taken.
Fuller and straighter, Rohit remains backward and turns it in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
On a length around off, Rahul pushes at it tentatively and gets an inside edge. Could have easily dragged it on. A single taken.
FOUR! Poor delivery, short and wide outside off, Rahul attacks it with all his might and slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Dickwella moves back.
A touch short in length around off, Rohit punches it off his back foot to sweeper cover for a single. India are away!

Back for the chase! KL Rahul and Rohit Sharma will open for India. Interestingly, Angelo Mathews to begin proceedings with the ball. Niroshan Dickwella standing up to the stumps. A slip in place. Here we go...
